description: WHICH NODES MIGHT THIS ONE RELATE TO — offered, never drawn. The missing half of half-idea linking: `unreviewed_ideas` counts the ideas connected to nothing, `review_relations` records the judgement, and until now NOTHING answered the question a person working that backlog actually has — which of these belong together? ⭐ EVERY CANDIDATE CARRIES THE WALK THAT PRODUCED IT in `because`: a shared neighbour (two nodes that both relate to a third are related in the graph’s own terms, whatever their words) or distinctive shared terms (weighted by rarity ACROSS THE POOL, so words true of everything count for nothing). A candidate whose reason cannot be stated is not offered. 🛑 IT NEVER WRITES AND NEVER PROPOSES AN EDGE. Ranking is the machine’s half; drawing is yours, through `review_relations`, and a false neighbour is worse than a missing one because anything searching by neighbourhood repeats it forever. Nodes ALREADY related are excluded from the ranking and returned in `already_related`, so ‘not offered because already linked’ is distinguishable from ‘not offered because nothing matched’. ⚠ AN EMPTY ANSWER SAYS WHICH EMPTY IT IS — `empty_because` separates ‘nothing to compare against’, ‘this node carries no comparable text’ and ‘ranked N and none matched’, because only the last means the node may be genuinely new. Needs no search index and no database, so it works in an index-less build.

limit.description:
How many candidates to return (default 5). Kept small on purpose: the
brainstorm rule is that two or three real relations is a good outcome
and ten is a smell.

node_id.description:
The node to find candidates FOR — usually an idea from
`unreviewed_ideas`.

node_type.description:
Its type (e.g. `Decision`).
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

pool_type.description:
What to rank it against. Omit to compare like with like (the same type
as the subject), which is what working an idea backlog wants.

name: relation_candidates
